articles.title: Did a tsunami hit the Bristol Channel four centuries ago? Revisiting the great flood of 1607
articles.summary: On January 30, 1607, a massive and sudden sea surge, possibly a tsunami, devastated the low-lying Bristol Channel and Severn estuary. A calm day turned catastrophic as the sea unexpectedly inundated coastal areas, causing widespread destruction and loss of life. This historical event, one of Britain's worst natural disasters, serves as a stark reminder of nature's formidable power and unpredictability.

articles.title: Boeing unfazed by India-EU FTA, says maintenance cost unlikely to decline soon
articles.summary: The India-EU Free Trade Agreement (FTA) is not expected to immediately lower costs for aircraft maintenance or spare parts. This is because India has already capped the tax on imported components, a policy that has largely addressed the potential for significant price reductions in this sector through the FTA. This reflects India's strategic management of its aviation industry's operational expenses.
